semanticExclusions: aggregate Statistics Overview values and formulas
Solo Record and Personal Best identities
single-match Hotseat, Online and Invite result identities
Power Index, trophies, medals and league or tournament ranks
avatars and friend or online presence states
gameplay dice, dice skins, navigation and Economy identities
rules: H2H-specific identities describe one rival or the H2H relationship, never a global aggregate.
Identical concepts reuse the locked Statistics Overview Fire Streak, Draws and Average identities.
Sharing a visual identity never merges H2H and aggregate data sources or formulas.
Highest Score remains distinct from Solo Record because its scope is one selected rival.
Worst Loss Margin remains distinct from aggregate Losses because it is a magnitude, not a count.
The wide Max Win Margin source and runtime preserve their native two-to-one aspect ratio.
No H2H asset belongs to the startup critical path.
